title: S1 Practice Quiz 2: Full Mixed — Hard
subtitle: Standards S1.a & S1.b · 7 Questions · ~35 min
purpose: Hard mixed S1 practice. S1.a with degree-4 terms and function notation. S1.b with binomial x trinomial and one box-reverse. All hard difficulty.

questions.question_html: Let \( f(x) = 2x^4 - 3x^3 + x^2 - 5 \) and \( g(x) = x^4 + 4x^3 - 2x^2 + 3x + 1 \). Find \( f(x) + g(x) \). Write your answer in standard form.
questions.hint: Line up like terms by degree: x^4, x^3, x^2, x, and constants. Add each column.

questions.question_html: Let \( f(x) = 3x^4 - 2x^3 + 5x - 8 \) and \( g(x) = x^4 + 3x^3 - 4x^2 + 2x - 3 \). Find \( f(x) - g(x) \). Write your answer in standard form.
questions.hint: Distribute the negative to every term of g(x). Note g(x) has no x^3 term in f(x) -- that column is just -3x^3.

questions.question_html:
Simplify. Write your answer in standard form.
\( (5x^3 - 2x^2 + 3x - 1) - (2x^3 + x^2 - 4x + 5) + (x^3 - 3x^2 + 2) \)
questions.hint: Subtract the second group first (flip all signs), then add the third. Collect by degree.

questions.question_html:
Multiply. Write your answer in standard form.
\( (3x^2 - 2x + 1)(x + 4) \)
questions.hint: Distribute x across the trinomial, then distribute 4. Combine the x^2 terms.

questions.question_html:
Multiply. Write your answer in standard form.
\( (2x^2 + x - 3)(x - 2) \)
questions.hint: Distribute x across the trinomial, then distribute -2. Watch the signs.

questions.question_html:
Multiply. Write your answer in standard form.
\( (x^2 - 3x + 2)(2x + 1) \)
questions.hint: Distribute 2x across the trinomial, then distribute 1. Combine the x^2 terms.

questions.question_html:
If you are given a factor and a final product, can you puzzle out what was multiplied?

\( (x + 4)(\,?\,) = x^3 + 7x^2 + 14x + 8 \)

Find the missing factor. Write your answer in standard form.
questions.hint: Start with the x^3 term: what times x gives x^3? That is your leading term. Work down by degree.
